title: Chinatown and Hidden Alleys Pedicab Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please put your desired departure time in the "special requirements field" when you book
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Non-motorized wheelchairs can be carried on board and assistance is given boarding and dismounting
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take a unique pedicab tour through Victoria's Old Town and Chinatown districts where you will be entertained with ghost stories as you pass shops that have been in business for over 100 years. Victoria has some wonderful hidden secrets which you'll learn as you roll through the streets and alleys.
